svg.font-family: 'Open Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Propellant per day in normal operation against what reads the tilt
svg.desc: Three bars. With the tilt rate taken from a noisy tilt reading the pods burn 24 tonnes a day. A rate sensor brings that to 9. With the pods left off below three thousandths of a degree it is 0.
svg.text: propellant burned in normal operation with nothing to hold, tonnes a day
Tilt rate found from a tilt reading with 0.001° of noise
The same reading, with a rate sensor good to 0.00003°/s
The rate sensor, and the pods left off below 0.003° of tilt
